newsitem.title: LEBANON: Solidere shares down on lower turnover on week.
newsitem.headline: Solidere shares down on lower turnover on week.

text.p: Solidere shares fell on lower turnover on the Beirut Stock Exchange (BSE) in the week ended on Friday and dealers said oversupply had pulled the shares down.
A shares fell to $113.875 from last Friday's $115 and B shares closed at $116.375, down from $117.875.
Both shares fell for four consecutive days from Monday reaching $111.375 and $115 respectively on Thursday before recovering on Friday.
"The oversupply of the shares was behind the fall in the price during most of the week," one dealer said.
The LISPI stock index fell 3.22 percent on the week to 81.98 and the BLOM stock index also fell 1.46 percent to 974.09.
Offer of Solidere A shares for the week totalled 182,095 against demand of 49,471. Some 99,543 B shares were offered against demand of 66,411.
Turnover was 45,934 shares from last week's 47,611 and value was $5,259,247.7915 from $5,502,419.255.
Trade in the other four listed shares on the BSE was quiet or non-existent during the week.

Some 5,000 Ciments Libanais shares were traded on Friday at $1.2812, down from their last trade at $1.3125 on November 5. Some 10,000 Eternit shares were traded at $1.50 on Wednesday and 100 changed hands shares at $1.5625 on Friday. Last week Eternit traded at $1.3125.
There was no trade for the fifth successive week in the two other listed companies: Ciments Blancs and Uniceramic.
